question: Has prior work already enriched triples with local context subgraphs for knowledge graph multi-hop question answering?
description: Determine if existing literature proposes adding surrounding triples from the same source passage as context to the target triple/path during training.
rationale: If such enrichment already exists, the novelty of the proposed method is reduced; if not, the idea may be novel.
resolution: Prior work enriches triples with subgraph context, but from the knowledge graph (e.g., SG-RAG MOT retrieves subgraph via Cypher and merges/orders triplets) rather than from the same source passage. The novelty of enriching with source‑passage subgraphs remains open.
